verdict.rationale: Brex publishes per-API reference pages (transactions, budgets, expenses, payments, team, webhooks) and an official Postman developer workspace with collections for all Brex APIs that users can fork and run, which provides runnable examples. However, nothing in the evidence shows an interactive in-docs 'try it' console, and the probe found no OpenAPI spec at the standard paths. Missing for 10: evidence of an in-browser interactive/runnable API explorer, a publicly fetchable OpenAPI spec, and hands-on corroboration of the reference experience.
